facts.note: The payment provider or receiving bank may require additional time.

facts.value: Subject to account limits, available balance, and payment-provider limits.
TradePro may not charge an internal withdrawal fee, but banks, payment providers, blockchain networks, or currency conversion may add charges.
Identity and account verification must be completed before a withdrawal can be approved.
Withdrawals may be returned to the original deposit method where required by payment rules and anti-money-laundering controls.
The withdrawal destination must generally be held in the verified account holder's name. Third-party withdrawals are not accepted.
A withdrawal cannot exceed the account's available withdrawable balance. Funds used as margin for open positions may not be available.
A withdrawal request may be declined or reduced if completing it would cause insufficient margin for open positions.
A currency conversion and provider exchange rate may apply when the withdrawal currency differs from the trading account or destination currency.
Business-day processing excludes weekends and relevant bank or public holidays.
A pending request may be cancellable before processing begins. Processed withdrawals cannot normally be cancelled.
TradePro may request additional documents or security confirmation before processing a withdrawal.
Withdrawal status should be checked from the account transaction or withdrawal history.
